install_steps: sudo apt install utimer  # Debian/Ubuntu; Arch: AUR package 'utimer'
note: Duration syntax mixes suffixes: d, h, m, s, ms (e.g. utimer -c 1h30m45s300ms). Use -q/--quiet to hide the live counter in scripts: 'utimer -q -c 10m && notify-send done'. Upstream lives on SourceForge; sarsolot/utimer on GitHub is a maintained fork adding a clock mode.
